name: Cedar Crossing Bridge
facts: Cedar Crossing Bridge, completed in 1982, is the sole covered bridge in Multnomah County, yet it defies tradition by eschewing a timber truss in favor of modern structural design.
The 24‑foot roadway of Cedar Crossing Bridge features five large windows on each side, while a separate 5‑foot walkway invites pedestrians to enjoy the creek below.
Despite graffiti, trash, and even bullet‑hole reports in 2015, the Portland Bureau of Transportation rated the bridge deck as satisfactory and the overall structure as fair or good in 2014.
